observed_revision_behavior: The revision route creates a distinct editable draft while preserving the published parent article.
An editable revision retains the base versionId until commit; the final receipt must identify version2.
Inherited expanded source files are removed through their inherited source archive, only inside the editable revision.
The top-level commit identifier may carry the hexagon: prefix; the receipt carries the bare article identifier.
Bearer authentication is sent only to the submission API, not to public work reads.
